metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to slide 5 and changed all textbox font colors to yellow (FFFF00) using Format > Character > Font Effects dialog.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate to specific slides, select all text in a textbox, use Format > Character dialog to set exact font colors via hex code.
metadata.task_rationale: Same operation as source task but targeting slide 3 instead of slide 5. Slide 3 has 'HELLO THERE!' (currently green #9EEFBC) and 'I'm Rain. Welcome...' (currently dark blue #14288F), making the initial state clearly different from yellow.
metadata.explanation: The evaluator downloads 1_2.pptx from the VM after saving, reads slide 3 (index 2) using python-pptx, extracts all text run font colors, and checks that every run has color FFFF00 (yellow). The initial state fails because slide 3 runs are green and blue. [Fixed: renamed getter/metric from truncated 8-char suffix '92512c76' to correct 32-char MD5 '9e2b961f79a8b89da2fe1a7f40c57f65']

scoring_breakdown.slide3_all_yellow: 1.0 - All text runs in slide 3 have font color #FFFF00

fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter 'get_pptx_slide3_text_colors__92512c76' to 'get_pptx_slide3_text_colors__9e2b961f79a8b89da2fe1a7f40c57f65' (invalid 8-char suffix -> correct 32-char MD5)
Fix 2: Renamed metric 'check_pptx_slide3_text_colors__92512c76' to 'check_pptx_slide3_text_colors__9e2b961f79a8b89da2fe1a7f40c57f65' (invalid 8-char suffix -> correct 32-char MD5)
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in task JSON to use the corrected 32-char MD5 hash

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves slide 3 via 0-indexed prs.slides[2], matching the instruction target.
Getter iterates all shapes with text frames, all paragraphs, and all runs — covering all textboxes on the slide.
Getter returns None for runs without an explicitly-set color type; metric correctly rejects any None (unset != yellow), making the check strict and correct.
Expected color FFFF00 exactly matches the instruction requirement of 'exactly yellow — no variations'.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the state is persisted correctly.
Negative control resistance is sound: initial slide 3 colors (green #9EEFBC and dark blue #14288F) will fail the check.

Minor concern: if LibreOffice stores color at paragraph/shape level rather than run level, run.font.color.type would be None and the check would fail even on a correct answer; however, the Format > Character dialog used by the agent sets run-level colors, so this is unlikely to be an issue in practice.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional robustness improvement: also check paragraph-level and shape-level color inheritance for runs where run.font.color.type is None, in case LibreOffice stores color at a higher level for some runs.
